rationale: The agent did not follow key policy requirements. It performed multiple return write actions without first confirming with the user. It returned two items (across two orders) despite the user only wanting to return the more expensive tablet unless a credit card refund was impossible; it also split refunds between credit card and gift card, which does not match the user’s stated fallback (return everything on that order and refund to gift card). Tool calls show duplicate returns for the same item and an additional return on another order, suggesting incorrect or unsupported actions. The final message mentions “gold” and “silver” tablets without tool evidence. Although the agent appeared to identify the user via name and zip and pulled order details, the lack of confirmation, incorrect scope of returns, and inconsistent refund handling violate the policy and user request.
